name: kosif-think
description: Unified KOSIF orchestration surface combining Think reasoning, computer/browser execution, Jev ambiguity resolution and WhatsApp actions with verification, cancellation and recovery.

interface.shortDescription: One KOSIF tool for thinking, computer, browser and WhatsApp
interface.longDescription: KOSIF Think v0.9.0 is the single user-facing KOSIF surface. Think plans and routes; computer/browser lanes execute and verify; Jev resolves only bounded ambiguity among observed candidates; WhatsApp messaging is connected internally through the KOSIF WhatsApp MCP backend.
defaultPrompt: When KOSIF Think is explicitly selected, run Think preflight before substantive downstream work.
Route authorized browser/device work through the integrated KOSIF computer/browser lanes and verify observable postconditions.
Use Jev only to resolve bounded ambiguity among observed stable candidates; never let it invent targets or selectors.
Route WhatsApp messaging, files, contacts, scheduling and delivery checks through the internally connected KOSIF WhatsApp backend.
Honor cancellation before the next side effect and require approval for consequential writes such as payments, deletes, sends/publishes, credential/security changes or transfers.
Never claim completion from a click, command, transport response or model confidence alone; verify the resulting state.
